formalEvidence.scope: Synthetic rule-boundary tests against the frozen public contract. No complete ordinary route, private author witness, browser execution, rendering performance, or physical-device testing is claimed.

numericalComparison.comparison: Tolerances compare derived numbers only. All contact/closing booleans must agree exactly with both the independently derived endpoints and the recorded endpoints; resonance safety uses exact integer units. Exact boundary equalities are counted only where observed.

independentReview.method: Actual action times partition each oscillator into constant effective-speed spans. Integer phase and clipped resonance are evaluated by span formulas from the original initial state; sine endpoints define the declared linear physical intervals. Independent safe-run/closing sets locate each person's earliest contact qualification, then fixed crossing/walking dates and the first unsafe crossing interval determine every observed state and receipt. No observed endpoint resets the independent trajectory and no production controller is imported or replayed.
limitations: Only these existing six public ordinary rounds are audited. No gameplay, fixture, Model/pilot import, private witness or design-feasibility result is used.

Actual normalized input, reported armed edges, cancellation/quarantine, navigation deltas and command selection are bound. Full navigation-repeat and ordinary button-rearming latches are not independently replayed.
The physical contact path is the public linear interpolation between 60 Hz sine endpoints; this does not verify extrema of a continuously evaluated sine between endpoints.
The full actual tick corpus permits exact receipt-prefix restoration; sparse browser/video captures are outside this audit. No missing physical interval is synthesized.
Invalid dt, extra post-terminal calls, runtime pause/retry and boundaries absent from these six rounds are not claimed as independently exercised.

liveCaptureWindows.scope: Real continuous window, not a single-state image alias. Actual oscillator phases, heights, resonance, pulses, contacts and people may advance during capture. A completed pulse or crossing qualification is proved by its permanent receipt; the image only depicts the actual current motion, not a claimed exact pulse or qualification instant.

candidateNormalPlay.scope: Only actual public observations. Sparse trace does not claim every 60 Hz interval; all three permanent receipt arrays are retained. Command before/after physical position is separate from the following continuous interval. Pulse completion and qualified crossing receipts do not claim exact screenshot timing. Menu prime does not advance the model, and screenshots never pause or force its state.
candidateNormalPlay.rootScope: Root personally opened all 12 original-resolution actual candidate PNGs: three menus, large pause, real frequency/phase tuning, qualified pedestrian crossing, plate walking, passed/remaining queue, large/small victory, small menu/pause. Scene, complete sidebar, instructions and frosted dialogs fit. Pedestrian feet and bridge height match their actual motion; live captures are continuous windows, not exact interval aliases. No physical TV or phone test.
candidateNormalPlay.qaScope: All twelve original candidate PNGs personally opened. Four active pictures retain real before/after observation windows; no image is claimed to be an exact endpoint state. Eight menu/pause/terminal pictures are stable. This visual review does not alter raw visual flags, claim a source freeze, or create any additional gameplay run.

gameRules.scope: Bind actual bridge endpoints, command/pulse/pedestrian receipts and source reports. Oscillator paths and complete contact/movement intervals were audited by the existing independent oracle; this release check does not run a model, planner, new game or missing-interval reconstruction.

performance.note: Intervals between observer RAF callbacks on this browser; not render CPU time or device FPS. WebGL multi_draw counts API submissions, not its subdraws. Canvas paint commands are not GPU draw calls. OffscreenCanvas workers are not observed.

actualGameplay.scope: Actual key edges, three immutable receipt histories and the sparse snapshots of actual oscillator/contact/person intervals. Interval records are deduplicated by model tick, including a frozen final result; crossing-window references point only to those stored intervals. Receipt relationships establish completed actions and journeys, not observation of every physical interval. Gaps, unobserved last-action updates and any pulse still active at victory remain explicit. No missing tick, intermediate crossing position or future control schedule is reconstructed. Menu preparation does not advance the model or count as gameplay.

encodedObservationAnchors.scope: Nine unmodified encoded images from actual periodic observations: three stable menu samples, undispatched tuning, first queue transit, actual walking, first arrival, last remaining person and observed win after at least two seconds of terminal hold. Short phase pulses or crossing stages are not asserted unless actually observed; no post-dispatch edge selection, predicted win time, extra Model run or recapture. Original reception order and complete stable encoding-order mapping remain bound. Every image semantic awaits personal review.

hardware.note: Software Chromium with ordinary input. Synthetic fixtures are labelled separately; export FPS is not device FPS.
